statement: Each handle is held with the middle finger at the declared grip centre and the hand along the declared hand axis
rationale: every wrist point in the reach count sits behind the declared grip; a hand that holds the handle elsewhere moves every reach with it

mechanism.how: Watch the two testers of REACH-HELD pick up the first full print without being told how: a hand that settles away from the marked grip centre, or along another axis, fails this
